questions.question: General Knowledge #1: Which constitutional or historical fact accurately describes Article 32?
options: Article 32 refers to an ancient taxation treaty repealed in 1950.
Article 32 is associated with: Right to Constitutional Remedies (Dr. Ambedkar called it Heart & Soul of Constitution).
Article 32 applies only during maritime emergencies.
Article 32 was declared invalid by the 100th Constitutional Amendment.
questions.hint: Article 32: Right to Constitutional Remedies (Dr. Ambedkar called it Heart & Soul of Constitution).

questions.question: General Knowledge #2: Which constitutional or historical fact accurately describes Lord Curzon?
options: Lord Curzon refers to an ancient taxation treaty repealed in 1950.
Lord Curzon is associated with: Partitioned Bengal in 1905, igniting the Swadeshi Movement.
Lord Curzon applies only during maritime emergencies.
Lord Curzon was declared invalid by the 100th Constitutional Amendment.
questions.hint: Lord Curzon: Partitioned Bengal in 1905, igniting the Swadeshi Movement.

questions.question: General Knowledge #3: Which constitutional or historical fact accurately describes Godavari River?

Godavari River applies only during maritime emergencies.
Godavari River was declared invalid by the 100th Constitutional Amendment.
questions.hint: Godavari River: Longest peninsular river in India, known as Dakshin Ganga.
